<thought>I will retrieve polymorphs for a diverse set of nitride compositions using the batch tool with the given energy and count limits, then consolidate the resulting JSON files into a single dataset and return its path.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
<action_input>{
  "compositions": [
    "AlN", "GaN", "InN", "BN", "Si3N4", "TiN", "ZrN", "HfN", "VN", "NbN",
    "TaN", "CrN", "MoN", "WN", "ReN", "ScN", "Y3N5", "Mg3N2", "Ca3N2",
    "Sr3N2", "Ba3N2", "Li3N", "Na3N", "K3N", "Zn3N2", "Cd3N2", "Pb3N4",
    "FeN", "CoN", "NiN"
  ],
  "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
  "max_per_composition": 3,
  "save_directory": "nitride_polymorphs"
}
</action_input>
